name: Cortina d'Ampezzo (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of blue and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cortina d'Ampezzo (a tower between fir trees on light blue) within branches, with the motto MODO VIVO AC TUTA QUIESCO on a scroll beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Cortina d'Ampezzo, a comune in Veneto; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 28 November 1928.

features.role: Cortina d'Ampezzo arms — tower between fir trees, crowned, within branches, with motto MODO VIVO AC TUTA QUIESCO
